data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter calendar picker with single, multi, and range selection modes.
data.what_it_does: Provides highly customizable calendar picker widgets and built-in dialogs supporting single, multi, and range date selection. It allows configuration over views (day, month, year, scroll), UI elements, and localization.
use_when: You need a calendar date picker supporting single, multi-date, or range selections.
You want to display a calendar inside a dialog with action buttons.
You need deep customization of the calendar UI and text styles.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, out-of-the-box Flutter Material CalendarDatePicker without customizations.
Your project relies on an older Flutter SDK that doesn't meet version requirements.
strengths: Supports single, multi, and range date picking modes.
Highly customizable UI and supports Material 3.
weaknesses: Requires managing a List of DateTimes for values.
Frequent SDK version bumps may require migration updates.
